constant-descriptor-concept.title: Represent constants with nominal descriptors
constant-descriptor-concept.short: Use the Constable API's symbolic descriptions
constant-descriptor-concept.summary: Constant descriptors in java.lang.constant symbolically describe classes, method types, method handles, and related constants.
constant-descriptor-concept.why: They represent class-file-like constants without requiring the described class or member to be loaded first.
constant-descriptor-concept.tips: ClassDesc.of accepts a binary class name; keep the descriptor distinct from an actual Class object.

classfile-api-concept.title: Work with class files using the Class-File API
classfile-api-concept.short: Parse, generate, and transform class files with a standard API
classfile-api-concept.summary: The Class-File API, finalized in Java 24, provides standard JDK facilities for reading and writing JVM class files.
classfile-api-concept.why: Tools can follow evolving class-file formats through a JDK-supported API.
classfile-api-concept.tips: Choose models and builders in java.lang.classfile according to whether you inspect or transform a class.

collectors-filtering.title: Filter inside a downstream collector
collectors-filtering.short: Use Collectors.filtering when filtering within groups
collectors-filtering.summary: Collectors.filtering passes only elements matching a predicate to its downstream collector.
collectors-filtering.why: Unlike filtering the whole stream first, it can preserve groups whose downstream result is empty.
collectors-filtering.tips: Use ordinary Stream.filter when you simply want to remove elements before all collection work.

collectors-flat-mapping.title: Flatten values inside a downstream collector
collectors-flat-mapping.short: Use Collectors.flatMapping for one-to-many values in groups
collectors-flat-mapping.summary: Collectors.flatMapping maps each input to a Stream and feeds that stream's elements to a downstream collector.
collectors-flat-mapping.why: It expresses one-to-many collection within groupingBy without manually accumulating nested collections.
collectors-flat-mapping.tips: Streams returned by the mapper are closed after their contents are consumed.

illformed-locale-exception.title: IllformedLocaleException
illformed-locale-exception.short: Pass well-formed BCP 47 data to Locale.Builder
illformed-locale-exception.summary: IllformedLocaleException is thrown when Locale.Builder receives syntactically invalid locale information.
illformed-locale-exception.why: Locale.Builder validates language tags and locale subtags while constructing a Locale.
illformed-locale-exception.tips: Use BCP 47 forms such as en-US for language tags.

layer-instantiation-exception.title: LayerInstantiationException
layer-instantiation-exception.short: Define module layers only from valid configurations
layer-instantiation-exception.summary: LayerInstantiationException reports a failure to create a module layer because its configuration or class-loader mapping violates layer constraints.
layer-instantiation-exception.why: A module layer must preserve rules such as valid package-to-module and loader relationships.
layer-instantiation-exception.tips: Validate the resolved configuration and class-loader mapping before defining a new layer.

sealed-direct-subclass-error.title: A sealed type rejects an unpermitted direct subclass
sealed-direct-subclass-error.short: Include every direct subclass in the permitted hierarchy
sealed-direct-subclass-error.summary: A direct subclass of a sealed class or interface must be explicitly or implicitly permitted by that sealed type.
sealed-direct-subclass-error.why: Sealed types let the declaration control the finite set of direct implementations.
sealed-direct-subclass-error.tips: A permitted subclass must itself be final, sealed, or non-sealed as required by the language rules.

annotation-default-null-error.title: An annotation element cannot default to null
annotation-default-null-error.short: Use a valid annotation element value as the default
annotation-default-null-error.summary: null is not permitted as the default value of an annotation element.
annotation-default-null-error.why: null is outside the set of values allowed for annotation elements.
annotation-default-null-error.tips: Use an explicit sentinel such as an empty string or a dedicated enum constant when appropriate.

auxiliary-class-access-warning.title: Warning for accessing an auxiliary class from another source file
auxiliary-class-access-warning.short: Place widely used top-level classes in matching source files
auxiliary-class-access-warning.summary: javac's auxiliaryclass lint warning detects access to a non-public top-level class declared in a different source file.
auxiliary-class-access-warning.why: Cross-file dependence on auxiliary top-level classes can make builds and source organization fragile.
auxiliary-class-access-warning.tips: Move a top-level class used across files into its own matching .java file.

collectors-to-map-duplicate-key-trap.title: Do not overlook duplicate keys in Collectors.toMap
collectors-to-map-duplicate-key-trap.short: Supply a merge function when duplicate keys are valid
collectors-to-map-duplicate-key-trap.summary: Collectors.toMap without a merge function throws IllegalStateException when multiple elements produce the same key.
collectors-to-map-duplicate-key-trap.why: The API cannot infer which value should win when keys collide.
collectors-to-map-duplicate-key-trap.tips: If duplicates are valid input, provide the three-argument overload with an explicit merge rule.
